none: PAS NLM-696E93: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Obverse inscription: [---]INVS AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [GLO]RIA EXER [CITVS]. Diameter: 12.7mm, Weight: 1.08gms, die axis: 12
